question: WINTER Olympics 2026 will be hosted by which of the following countries?
solution:
The correct option is__** Italy.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The first Winter Olympic Games, the** 1924 Winter Olympics**, were held in** Chamonix, France**.
 
• The Games were held every four years from 1924 to 1936, interrupted in 1940 and 1944 by World War II, and resumed in 1948.
 
• Five main sports** Bobsleigh, Curling, Ice Hockey, Nordic skiing, and Skating** are played in Winter Olympics.
 
• **The 2026 Winter Olympics will be hosted by Italy.**
 
• The Winter Olympic Games have been hosted on three continents by thirteen countries.
 
• The **USA** has hosted the Winter Olympics four times in **1932, 1960, 1980, and 2002**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Baron Pierre de Coubertin** founded the** International Olympic Committee (IOC) in 1894.**
 
• The first modern Summer Olympic Games were held in** Athens, Greece in 1896**.
 
• The ancient Olympic Games were held in Olympia, Greece, from the 8th century BC to the 4th century AD.
 
• Japan was the host nation of the 2020 Summer Olympics in Tokyo, 
 
• The Summer Olympics 2024 is organized in Paris.
 
• The last Summer Olympics was organized in Tokyo, Japan.
 
• Organizers of the 2024 Paris Olympics unveiled “Games Wide Open” as their official slogan on 25 July 2022.
 
• Having previously hosted in 1900 and 1924, Paris will be hosting the Summer Olympics third time in 2024.
 
• The 2024 Summer Olympics are scheduled to take place from July 26 to August 11, 2024.
 
• Athletes will compete in a total of 329 events in 32 sports.
 
• **Norway** was at the top in the medal tally in the 2022 Winter Olympics.
